text:
Noah (PM): Quick FYI00000000000000000
Repro: create 3 rules, drag #3 to top, immediately run Simulator. Sometimes Simulator shows old order.

Priya (Eng-UX): Can repro. We snapshot DOM order; setState batching occasionally makes that stale.

Samira (Design): Users get confused when list and simulator disagree. We should signal when simulator is catching up.

Lena (A11y): Keyboard reorder loses focus and announcements are stale. Need "Moved to position X of Y" announcements and stable focus restore.

Priya (Eng-UX): Plan: read order from canonical store after the commit, add a 100ms debounce guard, and show a tiny shimmer in the Simulator with aria-live text "Updating simulator to reflect latest rules".

Noah (PM): Prefer store-based capture. Also product asks for clearer conflict copy when rules overlap; current "Conflict" is too vague.

Samira (Design): Suggested copy: primary: "Rule conflict: 'geo=EU' overlaps with 'country=DE' in rule 'EU traffic'. Consider narrowing the condition or lowering priority." Short fallback: "Overlapping conditions between Rule A and Rule B."

Lena (A11y): When showing conflicts, focus the error summary and add a "Go to offending rule" button that moves keyboard focus into the rule card. Use aria-describedby linking.

Priya (Eng-UX): Backend returns conflicts with ids and fields. We'll map ids->names and render the primary copy. Also add unit tests that mock Context update timing to prevent regressions.

Noah (PM): UX question: badge numbering looks permanent. Users expect numbers to change during drag. Can we show saved index muted and a tentative blue index during drag plus an "Apply order" CTA?

Samira (Design): Two-state badge sounds good. For hosted customers default to auto-commit on drop (feature flag to disable for enterprise). Show an undo snackbar after auto-commit.

Lena (A11y): Undo must be keyboard-focusable and announced via aria-live: "Order saved. Undo." Undo should restore previous focus and order.

CI-Bot: CI queued for branch fix/sim-sync-order  tests running.

Priya (Eng-UX): I'll open PR with: store-based simulator capture, shimmer + aria-live, transient badges, keyboard focus fixes, and conflict copy mapping. Will include RTL/Jest tests and an a11y e2e.

Noah (PM): Great. Add copy variants and color tokens in the PR description. I'll add the sprint card and assign to Priya. Drop any extra edge cases (filters + canary + reorder) here.

Samira (Design): Uploading new highlight tokens for dark mode now; contrast notes included.

Lena (A11y): I'll add acceptance criteria for contrast and announcement text.
